items.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
items.summary: Researchers introduce OmniScientist, an AI capable of performing scientific tasks across multiple modalities and disciplines, marking a significant step towards general AI in scientific discovery.

items.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI 'teammate' just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
items.summary: Startup Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, claims its AI 'teammate' has surpassed models from Anthropic and OpenAI in the complex task of replicating scientific research.

items.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
items.summary: OpenAI has publicly advocated for California to enact a stronger AI safety bill, emphasizing the need for robust regulation in the rapidly evolving field.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
items.summary: OpenAI has launched a new version of ChatGPT specifically designed for teenagers, focusing on educational use cases and incorporating enhanced safety protections.

items.title: I'm 12. I don't have a laptop. I built a full-stack AI SaaS on my Android phone.
items.summary: A 12-year-old developer successfully built and launched a full-stack AI SaaS application using only an Android phone, demonstrating remarkable resourcefulness and the accessibility of AI development.

items.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
items.summary: SkillEvo proposes a novel method for AI agents to continuously improve their skills through self-renewing evolution gradients derived from multi-turn interaction feedback.

items.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
items.summary: Harvard's new $699 startup bootcamp is incorporating AI avatars of its instructors to enhance the learning experience and provide personalized guidance.

items.title: Claude Code costs up to $200 a month. Goose does the same thing for free.
items.summary: A new service named Goose is offering code generation capabilities comparable to Anthropic's Claude Code, but at no cost, potentially disrupting the market for AI coding assistants.

items.title: I Built an AI That Auto-Replies to Your Instagram DMs (No Login Required)
items.summary: A developer created an AI tool that automatically replies to Instagram DMs without requiring users to log in, offering a convenient and privacy-conscious solution.

items.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
items.summary: Repo0 introduces a novel design-driven approach to code generation, aiming to create entire software projects from initial design specifications.

items.title: 5 new ways to level up your learning with Search
items.summary: Google has introduced five new AI-powered features within Search designed to enhance learning and study tools for students and users.

items.title: The Planner Made the Same 3 Mistakes Every Time. A Bigger Model Didn't Fix It.
items.summary: This article discusses how simply scaling up an AI model did not resolve persistent planning errors, highlighting the need for qualitative improvements beyond model size.

items.title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
items.summary: This paper presents ForgeWM, a new approach for training video world models that can predict future frames based on actions, focusing on few-step causal progression.

items.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
items.summary: This research explores the challenge of 'unlearning' information in Large Language Models, proposing an adaptive popularity mechanism to address the difficulty of forgetting more popular data.

items.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
items.summary: Researchers introduce Centered Residual Signatures as a method to verify the training lineage of language models, providing a way to trace their development and potential influences.
